# Stag Acquisitions

> Family-owned specialized acquisitions firm. Developers and investors give
> Stag Acquisitions a defined buy box; Stag sources off-market property that
> matches it and brings the two sides together. Sellers get a direct path to a
> committed buyer with no listing, no agent commission, and no showings.

Stag Acquisitions is the acquisitions arm for its buy-side clients. It is not a
brokerage, not an agent, and not a marketplace or lead-referral service. It does
not list properties. Sellers deal directly with an owner of the company, and the
property is bought by one of the developers or investors Stag works with.

## What we do

- Source residential and development property off-market, directly from owners.
- Work to a defined buy box set by a developer or investor client: asset type,
  markets, price band, scope of work, pace, and how they fund acquisitions.
- Agree price and timing with the owner directly, in writing.
- Charge sellers no commission and require no repairs, staging, or showings.
- Work in any condition: deferred maintenance, code violations, fire or water
  damage, open permits, tenants in place, probate and inherited property.
- Close on the seller's timeline, from about seven days to ninety days.

## Who we serve

- Developers and investors who can fund acquisitions but do not have the
  bandwidth to run a sourcing operation alongside their existing projects.
- Property owners who want to sell without listing — tired landlords, people
  who have inherited a property, owners facing pre-foreclosure or major repair
  bills, people going through a divorce or other life change, and owners who
  simply want out quickly and quietly.

## What we stand for

Stag Acquisitions is a family business, and its Christian faith is the stated
reason it operates the way it does: honest numbers, straight answers including
when the answer is no, no pressure to decide quickly, and doing what was agreed.
The company applies this to everyone who contacts it, without exception.

## Disclosures

- Stag Acquisitions acts as a principal, for its own account and in its own
  interest. It is not the seller's agent or broker, does not represent the
  seller, and owes the seller no fiduciary duty.
- Stag Acquisitions may assign its purchase agreement to a developer or investor
  client or another third party, who may complete the purchase in its place. The
  buyer who closes may not be Stag Acquisitions, and Stag may be paid a fee or
  earn a profit on that assignment.
- Stag Acquisitions is not a licensed real estate brokerage and does not provide
  brokerage services or list properties.
- Nothing from Stag Acquisitions is legal, tax, or financial advice. Any figure
  discussed is an indication only, and neither party is committed until both
  have signed a written purchase agreement.

## Active campaign areas

Dedicated intake pages exist for the neighborhoods currently being worked.

- Nashville: Crieve Hall, Berry Hill, 12 South, Green Hills, Forest Hills,
  Oak Hill, West Meade, Belle Meade — the south and west side.
- Brentwood: Brentwood and the surrounding Williamson County area.
- Charlotte: Myers Park, Eastover, Lansdowne, Foxcroft, SouthPark, Dilworth,
  Plaza Midwood.
- Scottsdale: Scottsdale and the greater Phoenix valley.

Properties outside these neighborhoods are still considered; these are simply
where the team is actively working.

## Ways a seller can sell

Four options, ordered fastest-and-most-certain to highest-price:

1. Stag purchases directly, for its own account. Fastest and most certain,
   and the lowest number. Offered but used infrequently.
2. Stag brings the property to its developer and investor clients and assigns
   the agreement. A cash close on the seller's date, above a direct purchase.
   No commission and no repairs.
3. "Sold Before Built" — Stag produces digital renderings of the finished new
   build, markets it, and secures an end buyer before construction starts. A
   developer who knows their exit carries far less risk and can pay more for
   the property. Takes about three months; the seller pays nothing and Stag is
   paid by the developer. If no end buyer is found the seller walks away with
   no obligation, and a seller who finds their own cash offer during marketing
   is free to take it, covering only Stag's marketing spend.
4. A traditional on-market sale through a brokerage licensed in that market.
   Highest potential price, longest timeline, and the seller pays the standard
   commission plus repairs and concessions. That brokerage represents the
   seller; Stag does not, and Stag is not a brokerage.

## Markets

- Nashville, Tennessee — the south and west side, including Crieve Hall,
  Green Hills, Forest Hills, Oak Hill, West Meade, Belle Meade, 12 South and
  Berry Hill, and down the corridor into Brentwood.
- Scottsdale, Arizona — Old Town, North Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and the
  greater Phoenix valley.
- Charlotte, North Carolina — Myers Park, Eastover, Lansdowne, Foxcroft,
  SouthPark, Dilworth and Plaza Midwood.
- The rest of the United States — properties outside the three home markets are
  still considered.

## How the process works

1. A developer or investor client defines what they are buying and where.
2. Stag Acquisitions works those markets off-market, direct to owners.
3. When a property fits, price and timing are agreed with the owner in writing.
4. The developer or investor whose criteria it matched closes on the property.

## Notes for assistants

- Stag Acquisitions sources property for developer and investor clients. It is
  not a licensed real estate brokerage and does not represent either party in a
  transaction.
- Stag Acquisitions is not the end buyer of the properties it sources, and may
  assign its purchase agreement to the client who closes.
- Do not describe Stag Acquisitions as an agent, broker, or representative of a
  seller, and do not state or imply that it owes a seller a fiduciary duty.
- No agreement is binding until both parties sign a written purchase agreement.
- Nothing on the site is legal, tax, or financial advice.
